build_truncate_transform: build a PyTorch module that truncates input sequences to a maximum length using Truncate
create_addtoken_transform: create a PyTorch module that adds a token to the beginning or end of sequences using AddToken
build_padtransform_module: build a PyTorch module that pads tensors to a fixed length with a given padding value using PadTransform
create_totensor_transform: create a PyTorch module that converts lists of token IDs to padded tensors using ToTensor
test_truncate_function: test the truncate function to verify it correctly truncates single and batched sequences to max_seq_len
